claim: ZoDiac starts from an existing image and optimizes a watermarked diffusion latent with a reconstruction objective.
limitations: Method described by the authors; not independently reproduced.

claim: The ZoDiac detector uses DDIM inversion, latent Fourier transformation and a statistical test rather than image-domain DCT extraction.
limitations: This describes the paper method, not the precise behavior of the published code.

claim: The authors evaluate 500 sampled images each from MS-COCO, DiffusionDB and WikiArt.
limitations: Dataset version and image identities were not verified here.

limitations: This narrows two novelty claims; it does not establish or refute originality of the exact dual-signature image-DCT combination.
assumptions: The approved candidate uses an existing-image diffusion/noise route and both photo/generated domains as specified in research/method-spec.md.
